t: This is Clarence House, a royal residence beside St James's Palace, near The Mall. It was built between 1825 and 1827 for the Duke of Clarence, who became William IV. Queen Elizabeth the Queen Mother lived here from 1953 until 2002. Prince Philip lived here too, and Princess Anne was born here. Since 2003 it has been the main London home of Charles III and Camilla. So this one house carries several generations of the royal family, from a king who commissioned it to the king who lives in it now.
